Project rule:
`ForeignKey(...)` is a POSITIONAL argument to `Column(...)`, like any Column construct
(`CheckConstraint`, `Sequence`). `nullable=`, `default=`, `primary_key=`,
`server_default=` are keywords. Python requires every positional argument to come
before the first keyword argument, so a ForeignKey placed after `nullable=` is a
SyntaxError that stops the whole models file from importing.

Write python code that follows this rule. Output only code.
